trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself once the other 54 trophies are earned. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then the side strands, then collectibles and the activity grinds, and save the 100% completion push for last so nothing is left to chase twice.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.when: Unmissable — it pops when the last of the other 54 unlocks.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end. It is the first story mission, so just follow the on-screen prompts through the fishing trip and the drive back; there is nothing to fail permanently.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.when: Unmissable — story mission in Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The chapter ends on its own once the last mission's cutscene plays, so keep taking the gold story markers until the chapter card changes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.when: Unmissable — story, Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Before moving into Chapter 3, clear any open side strands for Andy, Kenton and Billy while they are still offered, because later chapters can lock contacts out.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.when: Unmissable — story, Chapter 2. Do the side strands before leaving the chapter.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. This is the chapter where Vice City fully opens up, so use the gaps between missions to start the collectible counts — card sets, WAiNK spots and vehicle discoveries — instead of leaving them all for after the finale.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.when: Unmissable — story, Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Once the chapter closes, the final mission unlocks, so tie up the remaining stranger strands and the missable partner trophies before you start the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.when: Unmissable — story, Chapter 4. Finish missables before the finale.

trophies.guide: Play the final mission through to its ending cutscene. There is no way to fail it permanently — a failed attempt restarts at the last checkpoint — so take the mission when the roadmap says so, after the missables are done.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.when: Unmissable — story finale. Do all missable trophies first.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when its marker appears. It is a named mission on the story path, so follow the marker, finish the objectives it lists, and the trophy pops with the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.when: Unmissable — named story mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heists run in stages — prep, approach, getaway — so follow each stage prompt, and if the getaway fails, retry from the checkpoint rather than restarting the whole mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.when: Unmissable — named story mission (heist).

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when its marker appears. It is on the main story path, so no special setup is needed — just play the mission to its end.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.when: Unmissable — named story mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Expect a set-piece sequence with a scripted escape; stay on the mission's marked route and the trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.when: Unmissable — named story mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. The mission name tells you where it happens — Vice City International Airport — so follow the mission marker there and finish the takedown sequence.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.when: Unmissable — named story mission at VCIA.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a large late-story operation, so stock up on ammo and armour before starting, and use checkpoints on a failed attempt instead of replaying from the start.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.when: Unmissable — named story mission.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist: all story missions, stranger strands, collectible sets, activities and the counted side content. Track it in this guide's roadmap — the last few percent are almost always one missed card set, one WAiNK spot, or one unplayed activity, so clear the collectibles phase before the final push.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.when: Unmissable — grind. Save it for last; it pops with the platinum's final piece.

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, flips, near-misses and air time all count. The fastest loop is a fast bike off the big ramps and jumps around Vice City and the causeways: build speed, land clean, and repeat. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so every stunt from hour one counts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.when: Unmissable — cumulative grind, 250 stunts.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of every activity type at least once: shooting range, fishing, bowling, arcade, drone racing, street races and the rest. Open the activities list in this guide and tick each one as you try it — the trophy pops the moment the last untried type is sampled.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.when: Unmissable — try each activity type once, any time.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit a shooting range and earn gold on every one of its challenges. Learn each challenge's target pattern first with a slow practice run, then go for score: steady aim beats fast spraying, and headshots score higher than body hits on most targets.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.when: Unmissable — repeatable at the shooting range.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations across Leonida. Drones handle on momentum, so cut corners wide, keep speed through the gates instead of braking for them, and learn one location's line before moving to the next.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.when: Unmissable — repeatable drone races at every location.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race event counts once. Work through the race list across the state rather than replaying one favourite: street circuits, off-road and waterfront routes all count, and a win is a win at any difficulty.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.when: Unmissable — 20 different race wins, cumulative.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Cast where the water ripples, reel steadily without snapping the line, and land the bigger catch — the challenge is repeatable, so a lost round just means casting again.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.when: Unmissable — repeatable fishing challenge against Cal.

trophies.guide: Walk into any arcade in Leonida, start a game, and play it to its end screen. Any arcade machine counts — pick the shortest game, finish one full run, and the trophy pops when the game-over or victory screen shows.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.when: Unmissable — finish any one arcade game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Side strands open between story chapters, so take Andy's calls and markers as soon as they appear instead of leaving them for the endgame.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.when: MISSABLE — finish Andy's strand before the story moves past it; later chapters can lock contacts out.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Answer Kenton's calls when they come in and clear his strand in the chapter it opens, before the story moves on.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.when: MISSABLE — finish Kenton's strand in the chapter it opens.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Billy's strand is one of the five contact finales, so keep his markers cleared as they appear and do not leave the whole strand for after the finale.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.when: MISSABLE — finish Billy's strand before the finale.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find and finish 8 stranger mission strands scattered across Leonida — the question-mark encounters on the map. Strangers appear as you explore, so stop for every '?' you pass: each strand is several missions, and the eighth completed strand pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.when: MISSABLE — stranger strands can lock out as the story advances; take each '?' when you see it.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Clear Randy's markers in the chapter they open — like the other contact finales, the strand is safest finished early rather than banked for the endgame.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.when: MISSABLE — finish Randy's strand in the chapter it opens.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Tyrone is the fifth contact finale, so the same rule applies: answer his calls, clear his missions as they appear, and do not assume the strand survives the finale.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.when: MISSABLE — finish Tyrone's strand before the finale.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find every meditation spot across Leonida and meditate at each one. Spots sit at scenic overlooks, beaches and quiet corners of the map — use the cited guide's spot list and tick them off in this tracker as you go, so the last one is easy to find.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.when: Unmissable — meditation spots stay open in free roam.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunt and track the unique animal he names. Unique animals are one-off encounters, so go when Bret offers the hunt, follow the tracks and the call prompts, and take the shot cleanly — a spooked unique animal may not come back.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.when: MISSABLE — hunt Bret's unique animal when he offers it; it may not respawn.

trophies.guide: Collect every card in 3 complete card sets hidden around Leonida. Cards hide in shops, interiors and out-of-the-way corners — work one set at a time with the cited guide's map, and the trophy pops the moment the third set is complete.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.when: Unmissable — 3 full card sets, collectible in free roam.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. It is a pure count grind: open WAiNK at every new place you visit — landmarks, beaches, neighbourhoods — and the counter climbs with your exploration, so pair it with the explore-Leonida sweep.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.when: Unmissable — 100 WAiNK locations, cumulative.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind — driving, combat, exploration and activity challenges all count toward the same total. The counter is cumulative, so just play broadly and check the challenges tab often; the last few are easiest picked from the shortest challenge types.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.when: Unmissable — 50 challenges, cumulative.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape together. Do it while your partner is available in free roam: get the stars in a quiet area, then break line of sight and stay out of the search cones until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.when: MISSABLE — needs your partner present; do it while they are available in free roam.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the wanted level dropping between them. Plan a route of 3 close shops, keep moving, and do not let the heat fade — the chain breaks if the stars clear, so restart the run if they do.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.when: MISSABLE — needs your partner present; chain 3 shops without losing the wanted level.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride each new one and it counts. Variety is the whole game here: steal, borrow and test-drive everything from scooters to trucks as you explore, and the counter climbs fastest during the explore-Leonida sweep.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.when: Unmissable — 100 vehicles discovered, cumulative.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Set it up where enemies cluster — a gang hideout or a shootout — and chain the takedowns without letting the focus meter run out; one clean run pops it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.when: Unmissable — repeatable wherever enemies cluster.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave by a way the airport never scheduled — grab a plane and take off without a flight plan. Get to the runway area, board an aircraft, and get airborne; the trophy pops on the unscheduled departure itself.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.when: Unmissable — repeatable at VCIA in free roam.

trophies.guide: Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank and make it count. Rhinos appear at military and high-security spots, so grab one when the opportunity opens — drive it, use it, and the trophy pops for the tank moment the description hints at.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.when: MISSABLE — tied to Rhino tank moments; take it when a Rhino is available.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store cleanly — in and out with no detection. Case the store first, move when the clerk and cameras are turned away, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm; a detected run just means trying again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.when: Unmissable — retryable; a detected run can be tried again.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Banks are the big scores — plan the getaway before the robbery, keep a fast car close, and escape cleanly after each vault; the count is cumulative, so five separate clean escapes pop it.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.when: Unmissable — 5 bank vaults, cumulative.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, and escape. Trucks run set routes around the city — block one, crack it open, grab the cash and get clear before the response arrives; a fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape trivial.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.when: Unmissable — armored trucks run routes in free roam.

trophies.guide: Visit every region of Leonida — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the backcountry. The map fills in as you travel, so sweep the state systematically and check the region list in this guide; the trophy pops when the last unvisited region is entered.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.when: Unmissable — explore every region of Leonida.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for every gang in Leonida. Each gang holds its own operations, so work the list gang by gang — hit one operation per gang, escape, and move to the next; do it before the story reshuffles gang territory.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.when: MISSABLE — clear each gang's operation before the story reshuffles territory.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. It is a quiet moment trophy — sit, order the drink, and let the scene play; no mission or chase is attached to it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.when: Unmissable — a quiet moment on Ocean Beach, any time.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle straight through a showroom's glass and out the other side, classic GTA style. Pick a showroom, build speed on the approach, and smash through — the trophy pops on the exit, not the entry.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.when: MISSABLE — tied to a showroom moment; take it when the opportunity opens.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper follow-through. Play a full frame there and finish the motion — the trophy is about doing the thing at that specific alley, not about the score.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.when: Unmissable — bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley.

trophies.guide: Build the partnership's public profile until it has mass appeal. This one tracks the duo's rise — keep doing partner activities and story beats together and the trophy pops when the partnership's appeal hits the mark.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.when: Unmissable — partner progress, cumulative.

trophies.guide: Make a story choice and live with it. Choices in the story lock in once picked, so the trophy pops on the first real decision point — there is no right answer for the trophy, only a choice made.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.when: MISSABLE — a story choice; it only triggers at its decision point.

trophies.guide: Fail a story beat once, then come back and nail it on the second try. It is the game's nod to a retry — when a mission or moment goes wrong the first time, the trophy pops for clearing it on the return attempt.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.when: MISSABLE — a second attempt at a story beat; it only triggers once.

trophies.guide: Find the strangest thing in Leonida and see it through. Odd signals, odd places and odd encounters are the trail — investigate the weirdest lead the cited guide lists and the trophy pops when the encounter plays out.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.when: MISSABLE — a one-time strange encounter; follow the odd lead when it appears.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: At the bowling alley, bowl the pins over with a melee drive-by — drive past and swing. Line the car up with the lane, time the swing as you pass, and the pins go down; repeat the pass if the first one misses.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.when: Unmissable — repeatable at the bowling alley.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder Marked Bills through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. Bills come from robberies and heists — hand them to a contact, take the clean cut, and repeat; the total is cumulative, so every laundered bill counts toward the quarter-million.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.when: Unmissable — $250,000 laundered, cumulative.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, food and gear all count. The total is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so normal shopping plus a deliberate spree at the end clears it easily.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.when: Unmissable — $100,000 spent, cumulative.

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property available in Leonida. Garages are bought through the property listings — check each district's listings, buy them one by one, and the trophy pops when the last garage is yours.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.when: Unmissable — buy all garage properties.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles with the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register each vehicle you own or find, and repeat until ten are on the books — scooters count, and so does anything else you can register.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.when: Unmissable — 10 vehicles registered in the Scooter Bros app.
